a story about someone special

A Day
With Kuku

Even when you're not here, Kuku —
somehow you're still everywhere. 🕊️

Kuku 🕊️ Darziii Jerry 🐈 Dumboo Kuchupuchu 🥰
scroll
6:00 AM · Good morning, Kuku 🕊️

I look at your picture, Darziii — smile quietly,
and wish you good morning.

That golden glow behind you — it's not just the photo.
That's just what Kuchupuchu looks like when she's happy. ✨

The little reminders for darziii 🕊️

📱

2:00 PM · Hey Kuchupuchu 🥰

Even your cat has that Kuku energy —
soft, calm, and quietly taking over the whole scene.

That bindi, those earrings — Darziii always puts thought into every little thing.
Green suits you, Kuku, like the colour was made for you specifically.
I had a whole conversation in my head meant for Kuchupuchu. Saving it.
The Spiderman filter — that was Dumboo's idea, wasn't it. Obviously. 🐈
6:30 PM · Missing Jerry 🐈
The day slows down. I check my phone, Kuku —
not out of habit. Not out of waiting.
Just because sharing small things
with Darziii has become part
of how my days feel complete.
That photo of us — your smile is different there, Kuchupuchu.
More comfortable. Like you knew exactly where you belonged.

Night · Goodnight, Dumboo 🐈

That glow behind you, Kuku — that's not just the photo.
That's just what Kuchupuchu looks like when she's truly at peace. 🕊️
A quiet realization
Maybe that's how someone like Kuku becomes important. Not all at once. Not through grand moments. But through the small things. The songs. The flowers. The jokes, Darziii. The stories. The mornings. The evenings. And the way she quietly became part
of almost every ordinary day. 🕊️

Kuku became part of my days
without me even noticing
when it happened.

Thank you for being my favourite part of ordinary days
— always yours, Darziii 🕊️
